findings.title: Late weather skips derived context during load tail
findings.issue: Health context is already published but isLoading remains true during sparkline awaits. Weather changes without updating coaching/briefing.
findings.suggestion: Use health publication readiness rather than loading completion.
findings.resolution: applyWeatherSnapshot uses hasLoadedOnce rather than !isLoading; weatherDuringLoadingTailRefreshesContext covers the published-health/loading-tail branch.

findings.title: Explicit permission refresh races background weather
findings.issue: Older background request can overwrite newer explicit weather because only load request ID is checked.
findings.suggestion: Coordinate both weather paths with a weather generation and cancellation.
findings.resolution: Shared weatherRequestID invalidates both directions; permissionWeatherSupersedesBackgroundWeather and dashboardWeatherSupersedesPermissionWeather cover reverse completion orders.

findings.title: Late weather restarts identical coaching inference
findings.issue: Late weather unconditionally cancels and repeats identical on-device AI prompt.
findings.suggestion: Preserve enhanced focus and active inference when the generated template is unchanged.
findings.resolution: Full generated template equality preserves the enhanced focus and existing inference; lateWeatherPreservesEnhancedCoaching awaits the actual AI task and proves one call.

findings.title: Obsolete response test relies on fixed sleep
findings.issue: 20ms sleep does not prove stale task processed its continuation before assertion.
findings.suggestion: Await the actual old task completion before asserting.
findings.resolution: Old and current weather task handles are awaited to completion; the fixed 20ms sleep was removed.
